# Contributing

Thank you for helping improve the EUDI Trust & Conformance Atlas.

This is an unofficial, community-maintained navigation resource.

## Rules

1. Prefer official sources: EUR-Lex, eudi.dev, official EU repositories, official project repos such as WE BUILD.
2. Do not add vendor marketing links unless clearly marked and justified.
3. Keep summaries neutral and factual.
4. Evidence mappings must cite official references where possible.
5. Do not claim that the site certifies compliance.
6. Official sources always prevail.

## What you can contribute

New document references, corrections, logical groupings, evidence mappings, glossary entries, links to official specs, test scenarios, broken-link fixes, UX improvements.

## License

By contributing, you agree your contribution is licensed under Apache-2.0.
